en.headline: Police charge 52-year-old domestic helper with murder over Kai Tak death
en.dek: The Indonesian helper who had been caring for a 93-year-old woman at Tak Long Estate faces a holding charge of murder and is due to appear in Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday.
body: Police on Tuesday laid a holding charge of murder against a 52-year-old Indonesian domestic helper in connection with the death of a 93-year-old woman she had been caring for at Tak Long Estate in Kai Tak.

The helper is due to appear at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday morning. She had been arrested earlier this week after the elderly woman was found unresponsive in their public-housing unit on Sunday morning and later certified dead at hospital.

Police said footage reviewed after the arrest showed the victim was struck multiple times. The case had already been classified as murder and the investigation transferred to a regional unit. The helper is accused of the offence; the matter is now before the court.
Relatives of the deceased had employed the helper since 2023 to provide care in the flat.

zh.headline: 警方暫控52歲外傭謀殺 啟德德朗邨九旬婦死亡案
zh.dek: 照顧德朗邨93歲女子的印尼外傭被暫控一項謀殺罪，案件周三上午在觀塘裁判法院提堂。
body: 警方周二暫控一名52歲印尼外籍家庭傭工一項謀殺罪，她涉嫌與啟德德朗邨一名93歲女子的死亡有關。
該外傭將於周三上午在觀塘裁判法院提堂。她較早前被捕；死者周日早上在其公屋單位內被發現毫無反應，其後在醫院證實不治。
警方表示，拘捕後檢視的片段顯示死者曾多次被襲擊。案件早前已列作謀殺，並由總區重案組跟進。外傭被控有關罪行，案件現交由法庭處理。
死者親屬自2023年起僱用該外傭在單位內提供照顧。
